entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to indicate successful attach procedure.

entities.name: EPS attach result
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of attach result.

entities.name: Combined EPS/IMSI attach successful
entities.description: Condition when EPS attach result IE indicates combined EPS/IMSI attach, meaning attach for EPS and non-EPS services or EPS services and SMS only were successful.

entities.name: EPS only attach successful
entities.description: Condition when EPS attach result IE indicates EPS only, meaning attach for EPS services was successful but attach for non-EPS services or SMS only failed.

relations.description: ATTACH ACCEPT message contains the EPS attach result IE.
EPS attach result IE value guards the condition for combined EPS/IMSI attach success.
EPS attach result IE value guards the condition for EPS only attach success.
